{{Top|leg}}
The '''Singing Forest''', known as '''''Keee-s'ae''''' in [[Gacerian (language)|Gacerian]], was a [[Forest/Legends|large, dense area]] containing [[s'ae tree]]s on the continent of [[An-Elto]]. The trees were sensitive to seismic activity; slight shifts in the bedrock caused the trees to resonate like tuning forks.
